run_human_agent: run the human agent to interact with a DeepMind Hard Eight task level via keyboard and mouse
run_agent_with_level: run the human agent with a specific level name and environment seed using absl flags
run_agent_with_docker: run the human agent using a custom Docker image name for the Hard Eight environment
review_KEYS_TO_ACTION: review the keyboard to action mapping dictionary that maps pygame keys to environment control actions
review_NO_ACTION: review the default no action dictionary that sets all movement and hand controls to zero
